summary_en: The video provides a detailed guide on preparing crispy sesame-fried frog legs in a modern kitchen studio. The host and chefs introduce the ingredients, mix seasonings, coat the meat in batter, fry it until golden brown in a pan, and present the final dish alongside mayonnaise sauce and salad.
